claims.evidence: Witness could not read any brand/model markings; no part number or OEM tag visible in the photo.
A small electrical connector/sensor wire is visible, but pin count is not countable from the image.
No VIN, part number, or compatibility sticker visible to confirm fitment years.
Surface grime and oxidation are visible, but internal condition (gears, clutches, seals) cannot be judged from an exterior photo.
Price opinion, not a verifiable physical fact.

risks.risk: Internal wear or damage to gears, clutches, torque converter
risks.proof: Video of the transmission being bench-tested or spun by hand showing smooth engagement, or a mechanic's inspection report
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested/unknown internal condition, worst case

risks.risk: Compatibility with a specific Camry model/year (automatic vs CVT, engine pairing)
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the part number/OEM tag or casting number stamped on the housing
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, buyer bears compatibility risk

risks.risk: Fluid leaks from seals or pan gasket
risks.proof: Video showing the unit with transmission fluid pan and seals, ideally after a brief test run
risks.if_unproven: priced as leaking/needs reseal until shown otherwise

risks.proof: Sharp close-up photo of the connector showing countable pins

risks.risk: Unknown mileage/usage history of donor vehicle
risks.proof: Any documentation, tag, or seller-provided odometer photo from the donor car
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage/unknown history, worst case

risks.risk: Scrapyard mix-up risk (wrong part swapped in, mismatched casing vs internals)
risks.proof: Photo showing matching part numbers on casing and any internal tags, plus full unit from multiple angles
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified single unit, no swap guarantee

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any stamped part number, casting number, or OEM tag on the housing
Clear photo of the electrical connector showing countable pins
Video of the transmission being manually turned or bench-tested
Photo of the unit from all sides including underside for leak/seal condition
Any paperwork or tag indicating the donor vehicle's year/mileage
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a transmission/gearbox assembly, so it can be priced generically at worst case; the seller's brand, year, and condition claims are unverifiable from the photo and should not raise the price until proven.
